# Synthetic data sets

**None of this is observation.** Every file, in both sets, is generated by `components/01_data_sources/make_synthetic_data.py`
for software testing. Every NetCDF file carries `comment = "SYNTHETIC DATA generated for software testing. NOT real observations."`
and `is_synthetic = "true"`; every CSV starts with the same sentence and `# synthetic: true`. The dashboard footer and every figure
caption repeat it. Platforms, ships and cruises are fictional (`SYN-A001`, `SYN-BUOY-AS01`, `SYN-CRUISE-2024-02`, `RV Synthetic Explorer`).
No real WMO number, buoy id or institution is used. `fetch_public_data.py` (the optional download of real public data) is a separate tool and is not touched.

| Profile | Command | Where | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `small` (default) | `python3 components/01_data_sources/make_synthetic_data.py` | `data/raw/` (5 files, 90 days) | unit tests and the phase 1–4 answer keys |
| `realistic` | `python3 components/01_data_sources/make_synthetic_data.py --profile realistic` | `data/realistic/` (16 files, 2024-01-01 .. 2025-12-31, about 29 MB) | demos, the dashboard, `tests/score_realistic.py` |

Both are deterministic: one seed each (`20250101`, `20261127`), same bytes on every run. `data/raw/MANIFEST.sha256` and
`data/realistic/MANIFEST.sha256` hold the sha256 of each file (`sha256sum -c MANIFEST.sha256` from inside the folder). Generation of the realistic set takes about 10 s.

## What the realistic set models (region 5°S–25°N, 50°E–100°E)

| Files | Content |
|---|---|
| `argo_profiles/argo_synthetic_{arabian_sea,bay_of_bengal,equatorial}_2024_2025.nc` | 40 fictional floats (20 / 15 / 5), 10-day cycles, 104 levels from 5 to 1950 m (dense near the surface). Seasonal mixed layer and thermocline; saline Arabian Sea against a freshened Bay of Bengal surface layer; a Persian Gulf tongue near 260 m and a deeper Red Sea tongue; a T–S relation that is statically stable (inversions are removed from the physics and only injected on purpose). Drift of a few km a day, about 3 % missed cycles, early deaths, late starts, some shallow cycles. Provider flags: about 92.7 % good, 3.3 % flag 2, 1.6 % flag 3, 0.6 % flag 4, 0.6 % flag 0, 1.1–1.5 % flag 9. |
| `ship_ctd/ctd_casts_synthetic_cruise01..06_*.csv` | 6 cruises, 150 casts, 1000–4000 m, deep water about 1.6 °C, same CSV format as before. |
| `sst_grid/sst_synthetic_0p25deg_2024_2025.nc` | 0.25° daily analysed SST for 731 days, int16 packed (scale 0.01, offset 273.15) like GHRSST. Monsoon cycle, spring warm pool above 30 °C, summer upwelling off Somalia and Oman, winter cooling in the north, land and coastal mask, cloud gaps (about 6 % in winter, more than 25 % in July). |
| `buoy_met_wave/buoy_met_wave_synthetic_{AS01..AS03,BB01,BB02}_2024_2025.csv` | 5 fictional hourly buoys. Monsoon wind reversal (south-west in summer, north-east in winter), 4 cyclone events (at most one per basin per year), pressure, air and sea temperature with a daily cycle, waves from wind sea plus swell, outages of 3 h to 2 days, sensor dropouts (fill value), and one buoy (BB01) silent for 21 days. |
| `bathymetry/bathymetry_synthetic_0p1deg_indian_ocean.nc` | 0.1° elevation for the whole region: shelf, slope, abyssal plain, three ridges, land. |

Every variable has small, slightly heavy-tailed natural noise.

## What is deliberately wrong

99 faults are injected. The **ground truth is outside the data**: `data/blind_errors/realistic/answer_key.csv` (same columns as the
earlier keys, plus `expect = detect | not_covered`). Only `tests/score_realistic.py` reads it. No label is inside a data file.

| Fault | Count | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| spike (temperature, salinity, wind, pressure …, 1.3–3 × the threshold) | 42 | detected |
| impossible value (salinity 52, temperature 61, wind 65 m/s) | 13 | detected |
| value replaced by the fill value | 7 | detected |
| density inversion | 9 | detected |
| position on land / swapped latitude and longitude | 7 | detected |
| duplicate, forward-jump and backwards timestamps | 9 | detected |
| stuck value (8 runs), salinity drift (2 floats), pressure offset (1 float), sensor drift (1 buoy) | 12 | **not covered**: the QC framework has no test for them. Reported, not counted as misses |

Side effects are honest, not hidden: one bad position stretches the dataset footprint on the map (it is computed from positions as delivered), and a bad timestamp makes its neighbours fail the monotonic test.

## Regenerate and check

```bash
python3 components/01_data_sources/make_synthetic_data.py --profile realistic
(cd data/realistic && sha256sum -c MANIFEST.sha256)
python3 tests/score_realistic.py          # ingest + QC of all 16 files, recall per fault type, flags by value, timings
python3 tests/dash_stack.py --port 18080  # the demo stack now loads data/realistic (use --data small for the five small files)
```

## Known effects of the larger set on the dashboard

The access API refuses a request longer than 366 days (`max_time_span_days`) or more than 5000 rows (`max_rows_subset`), so with two years the Profile, Series and Explore views need a From/To range, and the SST view a small box. The views show the API's own message. This is by design; nothing in the API or the UI was changed for the new data.
